title: The Light From Yesterday
idea: Because light takes time to travel, looking into space is also looking into the past.

title: Racing The Clock
idea: At very high speeds, time passes differently for the traveler and people on Earth.

title: Gravity Bends Time
idea: Strong gravity makes clocks tick slower compared with clocks farther away.

title: The Shortcut Through Time
idea: Wormholes are possible in some equations but not proven as usable time machines.

title: The Problem With Changing The Past
idea: Past time travel creates logical problems such as paradoxes and branching timelines.
